title: Grateful Dead Live at Red Rocks Ampitheatre on 1982-07-29
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) > Korg MR-1000 (1-bit/5.6MHz) > Audiogate (1-bit/5.6MHz > 16-bit/44.1kHz) > cdwav (edits)
source: Nakamichi CM-300 shotgun (CP-4) x2 > Cassette Master (Marantz Superscope CD320/Maxell UDXLII C-90)

ai_review.summary: Audience tape with decent clarity but noticeable pitch‑speed issues; the concert dazzles with a furnace‑blast first set and an unforgettable “I Need a Miracle” jam.
ai_review.review: The recording captures a solid audience source that is surprisingly clear for a crowd tape, though reviewers note it runs fast and needs several percent of pitch correction. Musically the show is a high‑energy highlight of the run – tight performances of Cassidy/Loser, a powerhouse Samson & Delilah, and a must‑hear “I Need a Miracle” jam leading into an inspired The Other One.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance (high energy, many standout songs) offset by technical recording flaws that require pitch correction; overall rating falls in the good‑to‑great range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear enough for an audience tape but runs fast (+2–3%) and needs pitch correction across sections; occasional AUD chatter, missing drums into Space in some edits, and a “swimmy” headphone feel. Second‑set clarity is better than first.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Considered the best of the three‑night run; a tight, furnace‑blast first set followed by a second set that builds through Cold Rain into a massive Miracle jam and a stormy The Other One.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals unusually forward; works hard on Looks Like Rain, matches Bob on Loser, dives into the G‑jam after I Need a Miracle.
band_member_comments.Phil: Provides his characteristic rumble during The Other One, locking down the band.
band_member_comments.Bob: Locks in with Jerry on Loser and briefly picks up the Crazy Fingers riff during the Miracle jam.
band_member_comments.Drums: Some sources miss drums into Space; overall decent but occasional edits affect continuity.
